nights.title: Ayşegül Aldinç
nights.name: Ayşegül Aldinç
nights.extract: Ayşegül Aldinç is a Turkish singer and actress.

nights.title: Kenan Doğulu
nights.name: Kenan Doğulu
nights.extract: Kenan Doğulu is a Turkish pop musician. He represented Turkey at the Eurovision Song Contest 2007 in Helsinki, where he was placed fourth, with 163 points. In the summer of 2006, Doğulu released the album Festival, containing the hit single "Çakkıdı", in collaboration with Sezen Aksu.

nights.title: Yüksek Sadakat
nights.name: Yüksek Sadakat
nights.extract: Yüksek Sadakat is a Turkish rock band that was formed in 1997 by Kutlu Özmakinacı, but became popular in early 2006 with their first album with the same name. The founder and bass player Kutlu Özmakinacı, used to be the editor of a music magazine called Blue Jean. Their music is a mix of pop rock with powerful beats utilizing Turkish instruments, keyboard and guitar solos. The name of the band is a literal translation of the term High Fidelity (Hi-Fi) into Turkish.

nights.title: Mabel Matiz
nights.name: Mabel Matiz
nights.extract: Fatih Karaca, better known by his stage name Mabel Matiz, is a Turkish pop music singer-songwriter.

nights.title: Ogün Sanlısoy
nights.name: Ogün Sanlısoy
nights.extract: Ogün Sanlısoy is a Turkish musician, vocalist and guitarist for thrash metal band Mezarkabul.

nights.title: Karsu
nights.name: Karsu
nights.extract: Karsu Dönmez, known mononymously as Karsu, is a Turkish-Dutch singer, pianist and composer. While her music style is a blend of various genres, jazz pop is probably the best description for it. She has songs in Dutch, English, and Turkish.

nights.title: Gökhan Türkmen
nights.name: Gökhan Türkmen
nights.extract: Gökhan Türkmen is a Turkish singer.

nights.title: Batu Akdeniz
nights.name: Batu Akdeniz
nights.extract: Batu Akdeniz is a Turkish rock musician. He is known for both his solo works and his collaborations with the Heavy Sky band.

nights.title: Blackbriar
nights.name: Blackbriar
nights.extract: Blackbriar is a Dutch alternative metal band from Assen. They have released three albums, four EPs, six singles, twelve official music videos, one official lyric video and four acoustic live videos.

nights.title: Emre Aydın
nights.name: Emre Aydın
nights.extract: Emre Aydın is a Turkish rock singer-songwriter. The singer won the MTV Europe Music Awards 2008 in the "Europe's Favourite Act" category. He is also the former lead singer for the Turkish rock band 6. Cadde.

nights.title: Soner Sarıkabadayı
nights.name: Soner Sarıkabadayı
nights.extract: Soner Sarıkabadayı is a Turkish pop music singer and songwriter.

nights.title: İlkay Akkaya
nights.name: İlkay Akkaya
nights.extract: İlkay Akkaya is a Turkish singer and member of the Turkish music group Grup Kızılırmak.
